items.title: Santander allows staff to count holidays and sick leave as days worked in office
items.summary: News of Spanish-owned lender’s policy emerges as other banks are toughening their stance on working from home Staff at the high street bank Santander have been permitted to log holiday and sick leave as days worked in the office, helping them to meet workplace attendance requirements. Back-office staff at the Spanish-owned lender have been expected to spend at least 12 working days each month in what the company calls a “head office location”, although this does not apply to staff working in bank branches.
